name: @platform/ui
$exports: The root entry pulls in components.tsx and therefore react-native. The web surfaces (apps/hq, apps/display) need the token and copy contracts and must not drag a native renderer into a Next bundle to get them, so the framework-free modules are addressable on their own. The ./src/* wildcard keeps the deep paths that predate this map resolvable -- adding `exports` without it would have made them hard errors (scripts/normalize-menu-images.ts).
